_comment: Bot personalities, keyed by the class 'ai' field. Ranges in metres. melee: never | close | prefer. usesVehicles: never | opportunistic | always. abilityEagerness scales every ability score. retreatHp = HP fraction below which the bot breaks off to heal or escape.

difficulty._comment: reactionTime: seconds before reacting to a new target/cast. aimSpeed: rad/s turn rate. aimError: degrees of wandering error. recoilComp: 0-1 share of recoil pulled down. interruptChance: odds of using a stun/silence on an enemy cast when able. command: the side's commander when the AI has the seat (src/ai/FrontlineCommander.js, src/ai/command/Strategist.js): obey, odds a squad goes at once when it can; interval, s between plans; hold, s a squad keeps a standing task before it's re-shared (default 20); mind, the Strategist commands (else plain standing orders); doctrine, its plan is made from the rules of the game (a squad on every point in the race for the middle, ahead one point held come what may, the main effort massed on his weakest point; else the standing orders' plan carried out well); allin, behind, every squad on the sector ahead; storm, the odds (our men within 110 m of a point to his round it) at which every squad there storms it (0: never); rescue, his men on a point of ours pull the nearest squads off whatever they're doing; barrage, the guns shell a point before it's stormed; noise, how far off its reading of the enemy can be; stage, attacks wait to go in together; scout, scouts out at once; fire, it calls fire missions; search, plans weighed per think beyond its plan (0: none; with search, also responses, margin, reserve). Doctrine knobs with defaults: mass 1.6, defend 1.1, garrison 3, picket 0.5, guard 2, spill 0.5, minMass 3.5, endgame 150 s, lines (the lanes' share; default line).
